top_signals.title: Bellway warns revived Help to Buy scheme could slow housing market
top_signals.summary: Bellway has warned the government’s revival of the Help to Buy scheme could further slow the housing market in the near term by encouraging housebuyers to delay decisions. top_signals.title: Modi Says India Is The Mother Of Democracy
top_signals.summary:
Speaking at the Bloomberg's New Economic Forum, India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that India is the mother of democracy where a wide range of issues are debated openly. 
This address is delivered in Hindi along with English translations. English closed captioning may not be available for all portions of the speech. (Source: Bloomberg)
